items.text: Kapaaran naka akaisaarei ka nuoŋon naka elap kalo ajaas idwe luka Isirael etukonokina kanuka ailuŋ, konapitos ipukoi, kojukitos da alup.
Kotiakar aur naka Isirael komo kere, kobwaata kolimonosi aronisiokee ka numam adolit nuka lukapapaakee.
Kobwaata kaiboisiokee, kosiomata kotoma oitabo loka ikisila luka EJAKAIT Ekecedeke kodaut atutubet nakiwononet naka apaaran; atutubet ace nakiwononet kolimosi, komaata EJAKAIT Ekecedeke,
Kosodete kobwaata Yesua, ka Bani, ka Kadumiel, ka Sebania, ka Buni, ka Serebia, ka Bani, ka Kenani, kadoketa nuka Ilebin, komonyakis EJAKAIT Ekecedeke keporoto loepol.

Kosodete Ilebin, Yesua, ka Kadumiel, ka Bani, ka Kasabaneia, ka Serebia, ka Kodia, ka Sebania, ka Petakia, kotemasi atiar, “Kobwaata, kimalata EJAKAIT Ekusideke, ameun ikar luno kiton ikar kere: kituritete ekonikiror loka aibuses, loitopolooritai aitelekarite aimal ka aiturit kere,
“Ŋo EJAKAIT, ijo bon ba, ibu kosub akuj, akui naka akuj, ka aiorekec kere, akwap ka iboro kere lueiaas toma, aŋololin da ka luejaas tomakee kere, ijo idari kes kere; kimai jo ajore kere naka akui,
Irai ijo EJAKAIT Edeke, loabu koseu Aburam ka alemun ŋes kour loka Ikaludean, kosodi amaikin ŋes ekiror Aburaam;

ibu kodum eketau erai lomunot kakonyenekon, kosodi kitutuk kaŋes aitutuket ainakin akwap naka Ekanaanit, ka Ekitit, ka Emorait, ka Eperisit, ka Eyebusit, ka Egirugasit, ainakin aurike, ido ibu ijo kitodolik akonikiro; naarai irai ijo loidolit.
“Ido ibu koany aiticanitoi naka lukapapaakosi koMisiri, kosodi apupun aimonyokec kariri naka Aŋolol Nakarenan;
kitodu da aanyuneta ka nukaumokin kama ejai Parao, ka ikekeiaanakinak kere, ka ituŋa kere luka akwapuke; naarai ibu kojen eiturikee kamakee; kodumunia ekiror, kwape ejaar lolo.
Ido ibu kotiak anolcl kakonyenekee, kitoroto kidin kaŋolol kakwap naconit; nul da luebwapitos kes ibu kocakak ataro, kwape ecakarere amoru toma akipi nuegogon.
Ido bobo ibu kinarenikinite kes kopir loka edou paaran; kopir da loka akim kuare; acaikinite kes korot lotikitoroto.
Ido ibu kodoku komoru Sinai, kinere kakes ijai toma akuj, kosodi ainakin kes itubesia luetenito, ka ikisila lukabeit, apueuneta ka aicorakineta nuejok.
Kiteienu kes asabatokon nakalaunan, kicorak kes aicorakineta, ka apucuneta, ka ekisil, kama ka Musa ekonikeiaanakinan,
Koinak da inyamat luapote kokuiu kanuka eteneikec, kitolomik kes akipi kotoma atiida kanuka akurekec, kicorak kolomasi airum akwap naibu korio akonikan ainakin kes.
“Konye kes ka lukapapaakos kiswamata keitur, kitininikata imurisiŋakee, komam epupunete aicorakinetakon,

koneroto arimar, mam da apotu kiitutu nnkaumokinikon nuibu kosub kotomakec; konye kitininikata imurisiŋakec, kibwaikis ekayaiton kipaliikis aboŋor obulesenekec, konye irai ijo Edeke loitemonokino aision, lokasianut, loileleba aitim, loiyapi anyunyurtkin, loepol aitim, mam ibu kojal kes.
Eebo, kedautu kesi asubun itaok yeniealara, kobalas ebe, ‘Yen ŋes Edekekon lokitolomuni koMisiri,’ ido kiswamatos nukitunyunyurikinete noi;

konye ijo kanuka aitimikon nakiponesio luipu mam ibu kojalak kes kamodiŋ: mam epir loka edou anyoununei kamakee paaran, ainarenikinite kes korot; karaida epir loka akim kuare, acaikinite kes, aitodikinitor erot lotikitoroto.
Ido ibu koinak ekonimoyo lokajokan aituutoonor kes, mam ibu kimik emanukon aitukekee, ibu koinak kes akipi kanuka akurekee.
Eebo, ibu kitanenenei kes ikar akaisaoŋon kamodiŋ, komamei ibore yenepudasi; mam ikeeenapen amoionenenete, mam akecekeien abuununete.
Ido ibu koinak kes ajakanuto ka atekerin, nuibu kokorak kwape ejaatar akorakinetakee: kosodete airum akwap naka Sikon, akwap naka eka baka loka Kesibon, ka akwap naka Og ekabaka loka Basan.
Ido ibu kitupuu ikeeedwe kwape aacer nukokuju, kitolomik da kes akwap, naibu kolimok lukapapaakec ebe elomarete airum.
Aso kolomasi idwe kirumata akwap, ibu kipiko lueboiete kakwap, Ikanaanin, kakonyenekee, kijaik akaninikec, ka ikabakanakec, ka atekerin nuka akwap, kiswamakis kes kwape kekotototor.

Kirumata ireria luabwaitai, ka akwap napusuk, kirumata itogoi luileleba iboro kere lukaiokak, amototin nuabokok, imanikoria luka emusabibu ka luka iseitunin, ka ikito luipu noi luka araito; asa konyamata, kimonikinos, kotumata, kisiyalamanakinete aiokisikon naepol.
“Konye komam erimarito, kipalionokinete jo, koeakasi ikonikisila kaukee, koarata inabinokon luetejenanakinete neejaas kesi aibelokin kes bobo neijai ijo, kiswamaenenete nukitunyunyurikinete noi,

Ŋes ibu kijaikinia kes akan naka lukasurupokee, luesiyalononoete kes: aso kapak naka ieanikee naamonyenenata neiiai, kopupununei ijai toma akuj; kwape ejaar akoniitim nakiponesio luipu koinak kes iketajarak luetajarenenete kes kakan naka lukasurupokee.

Konye nakedaununiata aiyeŋun, kiswamata bobo aronis kakonyenekon; - ŋes ibu kinyeinia kes akan naka lukasurupokee ayaite koyata kes: konye nakebonununioto, komonyakis jo, kopupununei ijai toma akui; koyuununei kes irwanipu kwape eiaar akoniitim.

Kitejenikin mama ejaas kesi, kosodi kinyaku bobo okisilakon: konye kiswamatos keitur, komam epupunete aicorakinetakon, konye kodiakanarete itubesiakon, (lutikiswama ituŋanan, tetere ejari kotomakec,) kolemununete kokeperinikee, kitininikata imurisiŋakec, koneroto apupun.
Konye kotitinonokini kes ikar luipu, kiteienikin mama ejaas kesi komoyokon kotoma onabinokon: konye koneroto aitoikin akit: ŋes ibu kokorakinia kes akan naka ituŋa luka akwapin.
Konye kanuka aitimikon naka iponesio luipu mam ibu kodau kes cut, karaida aijal kes; naarai irai ijo Edeke lokasianut ido loketimon.

“Aso do wu Edekekosi, Edeke lokapolon, lokapedor, Iokanosibib, loirieit aitutuket ka aitim, aitaaritoi kere nakidolokinit sio, ka ikosikabakan, ka ikosikapolok, ka isasedotinikosi, ka inabinokosi, ka ikonituŋa kere, agear apak naka ikabakan luka Asuria kiton lolo kinyek asubite bala edit kakonyenekon.
Konye irai ijo lokadoliton kakere nukidolokinete sio; naarai ibu kiswamaenenei nukabeit, konye sio kipou keswamaenenete nueroko:

karaida ikabakanakosi, ka ikapolokokosi, ka isasedotinikosi, karaida lukapapaakosi mam apotu korieenenete ikonikisila, kwabo mam eiranarete aicorakinetakon, ka aireienunetakon, nuitelenanakini ijo kes.
Naarai mam apotu kiiaanakis jo kotoma ajakanutukec, ido kotoma ajokisikon naepol naibu koinak, ido kakwap naepol napusuk naibu koinak kakonyenekee mam apotu kibelokinos anyoun kaswamisiokee nueroko.
Koany, kirai lolo ibulesin, akwap da naibu koinak lukapapaakosi anyamenen araitokeŋ ka aiokisiken, koany, kirai isio ibulesin kotomake,
Ido einakini ameda naepol ikabakan luibu ijo kibwaik ayait sio kanuka adiakanaretakosi: ido ejaas kes kapedor kawatekosi, ka ibarenekosi, kwape itoiokitotor kesi, kianyu isio ican luipu.”
Karaida keiaas ŋun kwaŋin konye kitutukinit aitutuket nakabeit, kiwadika da; ipueakinete da ikosikapolok, ka Ilebinikosi, ka isasedotinikosi aanyunetakee.
